requirement_in_plain_english: A full blood count, including the breakdown of white cells, must be done before every cycle.
exact_quote: Before each treatment: CBC & Diff
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary BRAJAC: Adjuvant therapy for breast cancer using doxorubicin and cyclophosphamide

requirement_in_plain_english: Give the full dose if neutrophils (infection-fighting white cells) are at least 1,500 per microlitre AND platelets (clotting cells) are at least 90,000. Between 70,000 and 89,000 platelets, give 75%.
exact_quote: Greater than or equal to 1.5 Greater than or equal to 90 100%
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary BRAJAC: Adjuvant therapy for breast cancer using doxorubicin and cyclophosphamide

requirement_in_plain_english: Doxorubicin is cleared by the liver. If bilirubin (a liver blood test) is 20-50 micromol/L (about 1.2-2.9 mg/dL), halve the dose; above 85, do not give it. Full dose only below 20 micromol/L.
exact_quote: >3 x ULN or 20-50 50% … - >85 do not administer
source: BC Cancer Drug Manual: Doxorubicin monograph

requirement_in_plain_english: Doxorubicin damages the heart in proportion to the total amount ever received. Add up every dose the patient has had (from any hospital); past 400 mg per square metre of body surface, the heart must be checked first.
exact_quote: Cardiac assessment recommended if lifelong dose of 400 mg/m2 to be exceeded
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary BRAJAC: Adjuvant therapy for breast cancer using doxorubicin and cyclophosphamide

requirement_in_plain_english: If the kidneys are working poorly, the cyclophosphamide dose may need to be lowered.
exact_quote: Renal dysfunction: Dose modification may be required for cyclophosphamide
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary BRAJAC: Adjuvant therapy for breast cancer using doxorubicin and cyclophosphamide

requirement_in_plain_english: A full blood count must be done before every weekly treatment.
exact_quote: Before each treatment: CBC & Diff
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary BRAJTTW: Adjuvant therapy for breast cancer using weekly paclitaxel and trastuzumab

requirement_in_plain_english: Weekly paclitaxel is given at full dose if neutrophils are at least 1,000 and platelets at least 90,000. Below that, call the doctor and delay.
exact_quote: Greater than or equal to 90 80 mg/m2 65 mg/m2 … ANC (x109/L) Greater than or equal to 1.0
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary BRAJTTW: Adjuvant therapy for breast cancer using weekly paclitaxel and trastuzumab

requirement_in_plain_english: Full-dose paclitaxel needs bilirubin no higher than 1.25 times the lab's upper normal limit. Between 1.26 and 2 times, the dose drops from 80 to 60.
exact_quote: Less than 10 x ULN and Less than or equal to 1.25 x ULN 80
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary BRAJTTW: Adjuvant therapy for breast cancer using weekly paclitaxel and trastuzumab

requirement_in_plain_english: The heart's pumping strength (LVEF, measured by echo scan) must be at least 50% to be eligible for this regimen.
exact_quote: LVEF greater than or equal to 50%
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary BRAJTTW: Adjuvant therapy for breast cancer using weekly paclitaxel and trastuzumab

requirement_in_plain_english: Doses are calculated from body weight, so weight is re-measured at every doctor visit and the dose changed if it has moved.
exact_quote: Weight will be measured at each scheduled physician's visit.
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary BRAJTTW: Adjuvant therapy for breast cancer using weekly paclitaxel and trastuzumab

requirement_in_plain_english: If more than 6 weeks have passed since the last trastuzumab dose, a larger 'loading' dose is needed again. Checkable from dates alone.
exact_quote: If an interruption in treatment of greater than 6 weeks occurs
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary BRAJTTW: Adjuvant therapy for breast cancer using weekly paclitaxel and trastuzumab

requirement_in_plain_english: Trastuzumab only works on HER2-positive cancer: the pathology report must say IHC 3+, or a FISH test must confirm it.
exact_quote: HER-2 overexpression defined as either IHC3+, or FISH amplification ratio greater than or equal to 2
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary BRAJTTW: Adjuvant therapy for breast cancer using weekly paclitaxel and trastuzumab

requirement_in_plain_english: ECOG is the doctor's 0-5 score of how well the patient manages daily life; 0-2 is well enough for this treatment.
exact_quote: ECOG status 0 to 2
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary BRAJTTW: Adjuvant therapy for breast cancer using weekly paclitaxel and trastuzumab

requirement_in_plain_english: A full blood count before every 3-weekly paclitaxel + trastuzumab cycle.
exact_quote: Before each treatment: CBC & Diff
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary BRAJACTT: Doxorubicin and cyclophosphamide followed by paclitaxel and trastuzumab (3-weekly)

requirement_in_plain_english: Full-dose paclitaxel 175 mg/m2 needs neutrophils at least 1,500 and platelets at least 90,000 (1.0-1.5 or 70,000-89,000: reduced dose).
exact_quote: Greater than or equal to 1.5 and Greater than or equal to 90 175 mg/m2
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary BRAJACTT: Doxorubicin and cyclophosphamide followed by paclitaxel and trastuzumab (3-weekly)

requirement_in_plain_english: While on trastuzumab, the heart must be checked by echo at least every 4 months.
exact_quote: The maximum time between cardiac monitoring should be 4 months
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary BRAJTR: Adjuvant trastuzumab following completion of chemotherapy

requirement_in_plain_english: Trastuzumab alone does not lower blood counts, so a blood count before each dose is optional.
exact_quote: CBC & Diff (optional and only if indicated)
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary BRAJTR: Adjuvant trastuzumab following completion of chemotherapy

requirement_in_plain_english: After doxorubicin-based chemotherapy and before trastuzumab starts, a new echo must show the heart at 50% or better.
exact_quote: LVEF greater than or equal to 50%* after the AC portion of chemotherapy
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary BRAJTR: Adjuvant trastuzumab following completion of chemotherapy

requirement_in_plain_english: Weight is measured at the start and at every doctor visit, because the dose depends on it.
exact_quote: Weight: at baseline and every scheduled physician's visit.
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary BRAJTR: Adjuvant trastuzumab following completion of chemotherapy

requirement_in_plain_english: More than 6 weeks since the last dose means a loading dose is needed again.
exact_quote: If an interruption in treatment of greater than 6 weeks occurs
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary BRAJTR: Adjuvant trastuzumab following completion of chemotherapy

requirement_in_plain_english: Before every cycle: blood count, creatinine (kidney), bilirubin and ALT (liver).
exact_quote: Prior to each cycle: CBC & Diff, creatinine, total bilirubin, ALT
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary GIAJFFOX: Adjuvant oxaliplatin, fluorouracil and leucovorin (FOLFOX) for colon cancer

requirement_in_plain_english: Hold FOLFOX only if neutrophils are below 1,200. (The missing space in 'Day 1of' is in the original document.)
exact_quote: If ANC less than 1.2 on Day 1of cycle, hold treatment.
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary GIAJFFOX: Adjuvant oxaliplatin, fluorouracil and leucovorin (FOLFOX) for colon cancer

requirement_in_plain_english: Hold FOLFOX only if platelets are below 75,000.
exact_quote: If platelets less than 75 on Day 1 of cycle, hold treatment.
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary GIAJFFOX: Adjuvant oxaliplatin, fluorouracil and leucovorin (FOLFOX) for colon cancer

requirement_in_plain_english: A one-time genetic blood test (DPYD) shows whether the body can break down fluorouracil. Without the enzyme, a normal dose can be fatal.
exact_quote: DPYD test (not required if previously tested, or tolerated fluorouracil or capecitabine)
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary GIAJFFOX: Adjuvant oxaliplatin, fluorouracil and leucovorin (FOLFOX) for colon cancer

requirement_in_plain_english: If the patient takes the blood thinner warfarin, a clotting test (INR) is needed before each cycle, because fluorouracil makes warfarin stronger.
exact_quote: For patients on warfarin, weekly INR during fluorouracil therapy until stable warfarin dose established, then INR prior to each cycle
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary GIAJFFOX: Adjuvant oxaliplatin, fluorouracil and leucovorin (FOLFOX) for colon cancer

requirement_in_plain_english: Before every cycle: blood count, kidney and liver tests.
exact_quote: Prior to each cycle: CBC & Diff, creatinine, total bilirubin, ALT
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary GIGAVCOX: Capecitabine and oxaliplatin (CAPOX) for advanced gastric cancer

requirement_in_plain_english: Hold CAPOX only if neutrophils are below 1,200.
exact_quote: If ANC less than 1.2 on Day 1 of cycle, hold treatment.
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary GIGAVCOX: Capecitabine and oxaliplatin (CAPOX) for advanced gastric cancer

requirement_in_plain_english: Hold CAPOX only if platelets are below 75,000.
exact_quote: If platelets less than 75 on Day 1 of cycle, hold treatment.
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary GIGAVCOX: Capecitabine and oxaliplatin (CAPOX) for advanced gastric cancer

requirement_in_plain_english: Stop capecitabine if kidney function (creatinine clearance) is below 30 mL/min.
exact_quote: Less than 30 Discontinue therapy
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary GIGAVCOX: Capecitabine and oxaliplatin (CAPOX) for advanced gastric cancer

requirement_in_plain_english: One-time DPYD genetic test before capecitabine; same danger as with fluorouracil.
exact_quote: DPYD test (not required if previously tested, or tolerated fluorouracil or capecitabine)
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary GIGAVCOX: Capecitabine and oxaliplatin (CAPOX) for advanced gastric cancer

requirement_in_plain_english: Before every cycle: blood count, creatinine, and the body salts (sodium, potassium, calcium, magnesium) that cisplatin drains through the kidneys.
exact_quote: Before each cycle: CBC & Diff, creatinine, sodium, potassium, calcium, albumin, magnesium.
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary HNLAPRT: Cisplatin with radiation for locally advanced head and neck cancer

requirement_in_plain_english: Full-dose cisplatin needs neutrophils at least 1,500 and platelets at least 100,000. (1,000-1,500 or 75,000-100,000: give 75%.)
exact_quote: greater than or equal to 1.5 and greater than or equal to 100 100%
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary HNLAPRT: Cisplatin with radiation for locally advanced head and neck cancer

requirement_in_plain_english: Cisplatin can damage the kidneys. Full dose at creatinine clearance 60 or more, 80% dose at 45-59, and hold below 45.
exact_quote: Less than 45 Hold CISplatin or delay with additional fluids
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary HNLAPRT: Cisplatin with radiation for locally advanced head and neck cancer

requirement_in_plain_english: Chemotherapy can wake up a hidden hepatitis B infection and cause liver failure, so patients are blood-tested for hepatitis B before starting.
exact_quote: All head and neck cancer patients undergoing chemoradiation should be screened for hepatitis B reactivation risk.
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary HNLAPRT: Cisplatin with radiation for locally advanced head and neck cancer

requirement_in_plain_english: Patient must be well enough day to day (doctor's 0-5 score of 0, 1 or 2).
exact_quote: ECOG performance status 0, 1, 2
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary HNLAPRT: Cisplatin with radiation for locally advanced head and neck cancer

requirement_in_plain_english: Before every weekly dose: blood count and creatinine.
exact_quote: Before each treatment: CBC & Diff, creatinine
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary GOCXCRT: Weekly cisplatin with radiation for cervical cancer

requirement_in_plain_english: Weekly cervix cisplatin proceeds with neutrophils of at least 800 and platelets of at least 80,000.
exact_quote: ANC greater than or equal to 0.8 Proceed with CISplatin … Platelets greater than or equal to 80 Proceed with treatment
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary GOCXCRT: Weekly cisplatin with radiation for cervical cancer

requirement_in_plain_english: Delay cisplatin if creatinine clearance is below 50 mL/min.
exact_quote: Less than 50 mL/minute Delay chemotherapy, recheck in 1 week
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary GOCXCRT: Weekly cisplatin with radiation for cervical cancer

requirement_in_plain_english: Before every cycle: blood count, kidney test and a full set of liver tests.
exact_quote: Before each treatment: CBC & Diff, creatinine, alkaline phosphatase, ALT, total bilirubin, LDH
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary LUAVPP: Platinum and pemetrexed for advanced non-small cell lung cancer

requirement_in_plain_english: Full dose needs neutrophils at least 1,500 and platelets at least 100,000; otherwise delay.
exact_quote: greater than or equal to 1.5 and greater than or equal to 100 100%
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary LUAVPP: Platinum and pemetrexed for advanced non-small cell lung cancer

requirement_in_plain_english: Hold pemetrexed if creatinine clearance is below 45 mL/min, whichever platinum drug is paired with it.
exact_quote: Less than 45 Hold
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary LUAVPP: Platinum and pemetrexed for advanced non-small cell lung cancer

requirement_in_plain_english: Pemetrexed is only safe if the patient has been taking folic acid for a week and has had a vitamin B12 injection (repeated every 9 weeks).
exact_quote: Vitamin supplementation mandatory starting at least 7 days prior to the first cycle
source: BC Cancer Protocol Summary LUAVPP: Platinum and pemetrexed for advanced non-small cell lung cancer

requirement_in_plain_english: Check the heart's pumping strength by echo before trastuzumab starts and regularly during it.
exact_quote: Assess left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) prior to initiation of Herceptin and at regular intervals during treatment.
source: US FDA prescribing information: Herceptin (trastuzumab), 2024

requirement_in_plain_english: Repeat the echo every 3 months while on trastuzumab.
exact_quote: LVEF measurements every 3 months during and upon completion of Herceptin
source: US FDA prescribing information: Herceptin (trastuzumab), 2024

requirement_in_plain_english: Stop trastuzumab if the heart's pumping strength falls 16 points or more from where it started.
exact_quote: Withhold Herceptin for ≥ 16% absolute decrease in LVEF from pre-treatment values
source: US FDA prescribing information: Herceptin (trastuzumab), 2024

requirement_in_plain_english: Trastuzumab harms an unborn baby (a boxed warning), so a pregnancy test is required before a woman who could be pregnant starts it. This is the same document SAARTHI already uses for its heart rules.
exact_quote: Verify the pregnancy status of females of reproductive potential prior to the initiation of Herceptin
source: US FDA prescribing information: Herceptin (trastuzumab), 2024

requirement_in_plain_english: There must be a written, signed chemotherapy order for this cycle.
exact_quote: Confirm the chemotherapy admission form/prescription form.
source: Miglani G et al. Chemotherapy administration checklist for patients receiving chemotherapy: development and validation. J Educ Health Promot 2022 (AIIMS Jodhpur). PMC9942124

requirement_in_plain_english: Known drug allergies and previous infusion reactions must be on record before the drip starts.
exact_quote: Review the patient's history of any known allergy/fluid restriction/nutritional deficit.
source: Miglani G et al. Chemotherapy administration checklist for patients receiving chemotherapy: development and validation. J Educ Health Promot 2022 (AIIMS Jodhpur). PMC9942124

requirement_in_plain_english: Blood tests must be on file: haemoglobin, white cells, platelets, liver tests and kidney tests.
exact_quote: Ensure patient's baseline laboratory reports like Hb, WBC, platelet count, LFT, RFT, etc.
source: Miglani G et al. Chemotherapy administration checklist for patients receiving chemotherapy: development and validation. J Educ Health Promot 2022 (AIIMS Jodhpur). PMC9942124

requirement_in_plain_english: A signed consent form for chemotherapy must be on file.
exact_quote: Obtain written informed consent from patient/family member.
source: Miglani G et al. Chemotherapy administration checklist for patients receiving chemotherapy: development and validation. J Educ Health Promot 2022 (AIIMS Jodhpur). PMC9942124

requirement_in_plain_english: Make sure this is the right patient.
exact_quote: Reconfirm the patient's identity and reassure the patient about the procedure.
source: Miglani G et al. Chemotherapy administration checklist for patients receiving chemotherapy: development and validation. J Educ Health Promot 2022 (AIIMS Jodhpur). PMC9942124

requirement_in_plain_english: When the patient leaves, the discharge paper must say the next cycle date and which blood tests to get before it.
exact_quote: Ensure the enclosure of discharge summary plan including date of next chemotherapy cycle and laboratory tests required.
source: Miglani G et al. Chemotherapy administration checklist for patients receiving chemotherapy: development and validation. J Educ Health Promot 2022 (AIIMS Jodhpur). PMC9942124

requirement_in_plain_english: India's National Cancer Grid: no cancer treatment starts until a pathology report (tissue or cell sample) confirms the cancer.
exact_quote: Histo/cyto pathology confirmation is a MUST before initiating cancer directed treatment (surgery/ chemotherapy/ other systemic treatment).
source: National Cancer Grid: Breast Cancer Management Guidelines 2019

requirement_in_plain_english: Under PM-JAY, every medical-oncology package (72 packages, 264 procedures) needs pre-authorisation before treatment.
exact_quote: Total number of packages: 72 Total number of procedures: 264 Pre-authorization: Mandatory for all packages
source: National Health Authority: Health Benefit Package 2.2 User Guidelines (PM-JAY)

requirement_in_plain_english: Each step of cancer treatment (each cycle or phase) needs its own pre-authorisation.
exact_quote: There should be pre-authorization at each step for cancer care
source: National Health Authority: Health Benefit Package 2.2 User Guidelines (PM-JAY)

requirement_in_plain_english: The treatment decision should come from a tumour board (surgeon, radiation oncologist and medical oncologist together), and be on record.
exact_quote: would need to be taken by a multidisciplinary tumor board
source: National Health Authority: Health Benefit Package 2.2 User Guidelines (PM-JAY)

requirement_in_plain_english: Each PM-JAY package has a fixed list of documents that must be uploaded before pre-authorisation can even be submitted.
exact_quote: Every procedure requires a set of mandatory documents to be uploaded at the time of submission of a pre-auth request.
source: National Health Authority: Health Benefit Package 2.2 User Guidelines (PM-JAY)

requirement_in_plain_english: REVIEWER: anything you check before a cycle that is not listed above
